description: A PHP class defining a model for handling product viewed reports in the OpenCart admin extension. It includes methods for installing/uninstalling the database table, adding report data, and retrieving viewed products statistics.

classes.name: ProductViewed
classes.description: Model class for managing product viewed data within the OpenCart report extension.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Creates the 'product_viewed' table in the database if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Drops the 'product_viewed' table from the database.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Inserts a record with product ID and view count into the 'product_viewed' table.

methods.name: getViewed
methods.description: Retrieves a list of products ordered by number of views, with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalViewed
methods.description: Returns the total number of views across all products.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the sum of viewed counts for all products.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total viewed count from the database.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Truncates the 'product_viewed' table, clearing all data.
